name: Ashbound Congregant
description: Cheap human worshipper. Within five cells of a Cantor or Processional Shrine, Conviction reduces damage and prevents dread. Enemy-caused deaths charge nearby Choir angels: three stacks maximum, six seconds.

name: Cantor of Desolation
description: Angelic overseer. Grants Conviction to nearby worshippers and enables Last Hymn martyrdom within five cells. Kill or isolate the Cantor to break the formation.

name: Retrieval Team
description: Black-site reconnaissance infantry with eight-cell sight and short-range cloak detection. Screens expensive experimental vehicles. Sample recovery remains future research.

name: Janus Tank
description: Experimental containment tank. SERAPH fires long-range precision shots; ABYSS delivers short-range infernal fire. A powered Containment Pylon is required. Protocol changes disable firing for three seconds.

name: Magistrate of Ash
description: Attacking pronounces Contempt: one visible target per player, ten-second mark, eight-second retarget cooldown. Circle attacks deal 15% extra damage; killing the condemned enemy grants six seconds of Ascendancy. Killing the Magistrate cancels the mark.

name: Contemptor
description: Armored close-range execution beast. Strong against damaged heavy targets; weak against cheap infantry screens. Gains 30% execution damage against targets below half health.

name: Processional Shrine
description: Powered four-person garrison and hymn relay. Extends Conviction and enables martyrdom within five cells. Empty shrines cannot shoot.

name: Containment Pylon
description: Powered null field suppresses Renewal, Blood Frenzy, dread and doctrine buffs within four cells, including friendly supernatural abilities. Select and Deploy (F) to switch SERAPH/ABYSS; oldest powered pylon controls your Janus tanks. Switching takes three seconds.

name: Throne of Scorn
description: Powered organic defense and command monument. If both attacker and its living Magistrate stand within five cells, condemnation damage rises from 15% to 30%.
